title.english: Apotheosis in Nine Acts: How I End Up Saving the World
synonyms: Apotheosis in Nine Acts: How I End Up Saving the World

synopsis:
The street thug Chu Sheng accidentally entered the cultivation world, hoping to win a comeback by clinging to the sect's back. Unexpectedly, the "Nine Laws of Ascension" turned out to be a mad evil art that uses living people as nourishment. The future mortal world has long been refined, filled with evil spirits, and even he, a Heavenly Dao Walker who "fuses all things," is merely a backup food for immortals. 

He gathers a group of outrageous teammates to travel through the future to eliminate evil spirits, with heavenly powers fighting against evil laws, and the bloody battles are packed with absurd laughs. The path to ascension is one where survival is one in ten, hoping to become immortal? Let's get through tonight first. 

(Source; Bilibili, translated)
